notes.title: DLC and Deluxe Edition is Now Available with 10% Discount
notes.notes:
Dear puzzle solvers,

We have published a DLC for One More Question, which contains original soundtracks, avatars and marks. Any related future contents will also be directly added to this DLC, so no other purchase is required. We hope to bring you a more customized experiences with every updates along the way.

To celebrate the launch of the Deluxe Edition, we have also given a 10% discount on the DLC to leave a bigger window of opportunity for those shopping on a budget. 

Staff: Design：雅虎
Art：二歪，阿纪
Composer：窦梵真
